CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  default_username text;
  raw_name text;
  raw_avatar text;
  clean_prefix text;
begin
  insert into public.users (id, email, account_status, created_at, updated_at)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.email, new.id::text || '@community.local'),
    'active',
    now(),
    now()
  )
  on conflict (id) do update set
    email = excluded.email,
    updated_at = now();

  raw_name := coalesce(
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name',
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name',
    split_part(new.email, '@', 1),
    'Community Member'
  );

  raw_avatar := coalesce(
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url',
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'picture',
    null
  );

  clean_prefix := lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(split_part(new.email, '@', 1), 'member'), '[^a-zA-Z0-9_]', '_', 'g'));
  if length(clean_prefix) < 3 then
    clean_prefix := 'user_' || clean_prefix;
  end if;

  default_username := clean_prefix || '_' || substr(replace(new.id::text, '-', ''), 1, 4);

  insert into public.profiles (
    id,
    username,
    display_name,
    avatar_url,
    status,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    last_active_at
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    default_username,
    raw_name,
    raw_avatar,
    'active',
    now(),
    now(),
    now()
  )
  on conflict (id) do update set
    last_active_at = now(),
    avatar_url = coalesce(public.profiles.avatar_url, excluded.avatar_url);

  insert into public.user_roles (profile_id, role)
  values (new.id, 'member')
  on conflict do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select public.has_permission(actor_id, 'events.manage');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_permission(actor_id uuid, permission_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select case
    when actor_id is null or permission_key is null then false
    when not public.is_active_account(actor_id) then false
    when public.is_super_admin(actor_id) then true
    when exists (
      select 1
      from public.user_admin_roles uar
      join public.admin_role_permissions arp on arp.role_id = uar.role_id
      join public.permissions p on p.id = arp.permission_id
      where uar.user_id = actor_id
        and p.key = permission_key
    ) then true
    else exists (
      select 1
      from public.user_roles ur
      where ur.profile_id = actor_id
        and (
          (
            ur.role = 'admin'
            and permission_key in (
              'dashboard.read', 'users.manage', 'categories.manage',
              'projects.moderate', 'articles.create', 'articles.publish',
              'articles.manage', 'articles.delete', 'events.manage',
              'badges.manage', 'reports.manage', 'discord.manage',
              'audit_logs.read', 'roles.manage', 'site.manage'
            )
          )
          or (
            ur.role = 'moderator'
            and permission_key in (
              'dashboard.read', 'projects.moderate', 'articles.create',
              'articles.publish', 'articles.moderate', 'reports.manage'
            )
          )
          or (
            ur.role = 'event_organizer'
            and permission_key in ('dashboard.read', 'events.manage')
          )
        )
    )
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_account(actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.users u
    join public.profiles p on p.id = u.id
    where u.id = actor_id
      and u.account_status = 'active'
      and p.status = 'active'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_admin(actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select public.is_active_account(actor_id)
    and (
      exists (
        select 1
        from public.user_roles
        where profile_id = actor_id
          and role = 'super_admin'
      )
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.user_admin_roles uar
        join public.admin_roles ar on ar.id = uar.role_id
        where uar.user_id = actor_id
          and ar.slug = 'super_admin'
      )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_members_of_published_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status = 'published' and (tg_op = 'INSERT' or old.status is distinct from 'published') then
    insert into public.notifications (profile_id, type, title, body, resource_type, resource_id)
    select p.id,
      'event_published',
      'New community event',
      'The DropOut College announced a new event: ' || new.title,
      'event',
      new.id
    from public.profiles p
    where p.status = 'active'
      and p.id <> new.created_by;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_site_cms(p_settings jsonb, p_sections jsonb, p_social_links jsonb, p_announcements jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_founders jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_permission(auth.uid(), 'site.manage') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Site management permission is required.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF p_settings IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(p_settings) = 'object' THEN
    UPDATE public.site_settings
    SET
      site_name = COALESCE(p_settings->>'site_name', site_name),
      site_description = COALESCE(p_settings->>'site_description', site_description),
      hero_title = COALESCE(p_settings->>'hero_title', hero_title),
      hero_subtitle = COALESCE(p_settings->>'hero_subtitle', hero_subtitle),
      hero_description = COALESCE(p_settings->>'hero_description', hero_description),
      hero_badge_text = COALESCE(p_settings->>'hero_badge_text', hero_badge_text),
      hero_primary_cta_label = COALESCE(p_settings->>'hero_primary_cta_label', hero_primary_cta_label),
      hero_primary_cta_href = COALESCE(p_settings->>'hero_primary_cta_href', hero_primary_cta_href),
      hero_secondary_cta_label = COALESCE(p_settings->>'hero_secondary_cta_label', hero_secondary_cta_label),
      hero_secondary_cta_href = COALESCE(p_settings->>'hero_secondary_cta_href', hero_secondary_cta_href),
      who_we_are = COALESCE(p_settings->>'who_we_are', who_we_are),
      our_aim = COALESCE(p_settings->>'our_aim', our_aim),
      our_goal = COALESCE(p_settings->>'our_goal', our_goal),
      our_story = COALESCE(p_settings->>'our_story', our_story),
      our_vision = COALESCE(p_settings->>'our_vision', our_vision),
      our_mission = COALESCE(p_settings->>'our_mission', our_mission),
      our_philosophy = COALESCE(p_settings->>'our_philosophy', our_philosophy),
      footer_description = COALESCE(p_settings->>'footer_text', footer_description),
      community_invite_link = COALESCE(p_settings->>'community_invite_link', p_settings->>'discord_link', community_invite_link),
      contact_email = COALESCE(p_settings->>'contact_email', contact_email),
      contact_phone = COALESCE(p_settings->>'contact_phone', contact_phone),
      discord_link = COALESCE(p_settings->>'discord_link', p_settings->>'community_invite_link', discord_link),
      github_link = COALESCE(p_settings->>'github_link', github_link),
      facebook_link = COALESCE(p_settings->>'facebook_link', facebook_link),
      instagram_link = COALESCE(p_settings->>'instagram_link', instagram_link),
      youtube_link = COALESCE(p_settings->>'youtube_link', youtube_link),
      updated_at = NOW();
  END IF;

  IF p_sections IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(p_sections) = 'array' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.site_sections (
      key, slug, title, description, cta_label, cta_href, is_enabled, enabled, sort_order, config, content, updated_at
    )
    SELECT
      sec.slug,
      sec.slug,
      COALESCE(sec.title, ''),
      COALESCE(sec.description, ''),
      COALESCE(sec.cta_label, ''),
      COALESCE(sec.cta_href, ''),
      COALESCE(sec.enabled, true),
      COALESCE(sec.enabled, true),
      COALESCE(sec.sort_order, 0),
      COALESCE(sec.content, '{}'::jsonb),
      COALESCE(sec.content, '{}'::jsonb),
      NOW()
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_sections) AS sec(
      slug text,
      title text,
      description text,
      cta_label text,
      cta_href text,
      enabled boolean,
      sort_order integer,
      content jsonb
    )
    ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET
      slug = EXCLUDED.slug,
      title = EXCLUDED.title,
      description = EXCLUDED.description,
      cta_label = EXCLUDED.cta_label,
      cta_href = EXCLUDED.cta_href,
      is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled,
      enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled,
      sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order,
      config = EXCLUDED.config,
      content = EXCLUDED.content,
      updated_at = NOW();
  END IF;

  IF p_announcements IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(p_announcements) = 'array' THEN
    UPDATE public.site_sections
    SET
      config = jsonb_set(COALESCE(config, '{}'::jsonb), '{announcements}', p_announcements),
      content = jsonb_set(COALESCE(content, '{}'::jsonb), '{announcements}', p_announcements),
      updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE key = 'community-noticeboard' OR slug = 'community-noticeboard';
  END IF;

  IF p_founders IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(p_founders) = 'array' THEN
    UPDATE public.site_sections
    SET
      config = jsonb_set(COALESCE(config, '{}'::jsonb), '{founders}', p_founders),
      content = jsonb_set(COALESCE(content, '{}'::jsonb), '{founders}', p_founders),
      updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE key = 'founders' OR slug = 'founders';
  END IF;

  IF p_social_links IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(p_social_links) = 'array' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.site_social_links (
      platform, url, is_active, sort_order, updated_at
    )
    SELECT
      soc.platform,
      COALESCE(soc.url, ''),
      COALESCE(soc.enabled, true),
      COALESCE(soc.sort_order, 0),
      NOW()
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_social_links) AS soc(
      platform text,
      url text,
      enabled boolean,
      sort_order integer
    )
    ON CONFLICT (platform) DO UPDATE SET
      url = EXCLUDED.url,
      is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active,
      sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order,
      updated_at = NOW();
  END IF;
END;
$function$
